spec.description: The 540-ds MCP server gives an AI agent a registry of read-only tools (mcp/tools/index.ts) to query the design system while it assembles a piece: get-design-guide, list-templates, get-rules, get-template, get-patterns, get-template-stops, list-components, search-components, get-component, get-component-docs, get-component-stories, get-tokens and search-images. Every listed tool is annotated read-only. get-design-guide returns src/docs/diseno.md without the note for editors. list-templates lists every piece type in PIECE_TYPES with what it is, its triggers and the tools that have data for it, and the pieceType enum of the template tools is taken from the same source (PIECE_TYPE_IDS). Only talks are served: any other piece type is refused. get-rules returns the talk rules, also when no pieceType is given. list-components filters by level. get-component returns props with their types, defaults and descriptions, finds parts and tag names, and, when it finds none, suggests up to five component or part names only where the normalized name contains the normalized query, or the normalized query, longer than 2 characters, contains the name; a typo such as "Buton" gets no suggestion. get-component-docs returns the component's sheet in Markdown. get-component-stories includes story code only when asked. search-components is a literal text match, not a match by meaning: it folds the query (accents removed, lowercase), splits it into terms longer than one character, and scores each term found as literal text in the component and part names (10), their descriptions (4), the prop names and descriptions (2) and the docs (1 per occurrence, at most 5), returning the 8 highest-scoring components; a Spanish word such as "cita" finds a component only because its docs are in Spanish and contain that word. get-tokens filters by category and text. get-template gives the shell and the index of stops without their code. get-template-stops returns each stop's code with its helpers and sample assets, and reports ids it does not know. search-images finds photos by theme, applies filters and skips photos already used. get-patterns filters by need and points to stops.
